title: 整环、域与除环
Integral domains, fields and division rings
非零乘非零，也可能为零
Nonzero times nonzero can vanish
text: 若 a、b 非零而 ab=0，教材称 a 为左零因子，b 为右零因子。没有任何零因子的环称无零因子环。交换环中左右不必区分。

If nonzero a,b satisfy ab=0, the textbook calls a a left zero-divisor and b a right zero-divisor. A ring without either kind is a ring without zero-divisors. In a commutative ring the distinction disappears.
example: ℤ₆ 中 2·3=0；矩阵环中 E₁₂²=0。零元本身不列为零因子。
In ℤ₆, 2·3=0; in a matrix ring E₁₂²=0. By convention, zero itself is not a zero-divisor.

title: 什么时候可以约去一个因子？
When may a factor be cancelled?
text: 无零因子环满足左右乘法消去律；反过来，任一侧对所有非零因子的消去律，都足以排除零因子。
A ring without zero-divisors has both cancellation laws for nonzero factors. Conversely, either cancellation law, applied to every nonzero factor, rules out zero-divisors.
proof: 由 ac=bc 得 (a−b)c=0。若 c≠0 且无零因子，则 a−b=0。左消去同理。
If ac=bc, then (a−b)c=0. With c nonzero and no zero-divisors, a=b. Left cancellation is similar.
反向若 ab=0 且 b≠0，则 ab=0b，右消去得 a=0；左消去也能给出同样结论。
Conversely, if ab=0 with b≠0, right cancellation in ab=0b gives a=0. Left cancellation gives the analogous argument.
warning: ℤ₆ 中 2·1=2·4，却不能推出 1=4。先检查被约去的因子是不是零因子。
In ℤ₆, 2·1=2·4 but 1≠4. Check the factor before cancelling.

title: 整环：最接近整数的环
Domains: rings resembling the integers
text: 整环是有单位元 1≠0、交换且无零因子的环。ℤ、ℤ[i]、域上的多项式环都是例子；2ℤ 无零因子却因无单位元而不是整环。

A domain is a commutative ring with 1≠0 and no zero-divisors. Examples include ℤ, ℤ[i] and polynomial rings over fields. The ring 2ℤ has no zero-divisors but is not a domain because it lacks an identity.
example: 在高斯整环中 N(a+bi)=a²+b²，N(zw)=N(z)N(w)。单位的范数必须为 1，故单位恰为 ±1、±i。
For Gaussian integers N(a+bi)=a²+b² is multiplicative. A unit must have norm 1, giving exactly ±1 and ±i.

title: 域：每个非零元素都可逆
Fields: every nonzero element is invertible
text: 域是有单位元的交换环，且每个非零元素可逆。域一定是整环，整环不一定是域。对 n≥2，ℤₙ 是域当且仅当 n 是素数。
A field is a commutative unital ring in which every nonzero element is invertible. Every field is a domain, but not conversely. For n≥2, ℤₙ is a field exactly when n is prime.
proof: 若域中 ab=0 且 a≠0，乘以 a⁻¹ 得 b=0，因此没有零因子。
In a field, ab=0 and a≠0 imply b=0 after multiplying by a⁻¹.
若 n=p 为素数，对非零 [a] 有 gcd(a,p)=1，Bézout 等式给出逆元。
If n=p is prime, every nonzero [a] is coprime to p and Bézout gives an inverse.
若 n=uv 为合数且 1<u,v<n，则 [u][v]=0 而两因子非零，所以不是域。
If n=uv is composite with 1<u,v<n, the two nonzero classes have zero product.
warning: ℤ 中 2 不可逆；域中也不能除以 0。
The integer 2 is not a unit in ℤ. Even in a field, division by zero is impossible.

title: 有限整环一定是域
Every finite domain is a field
text: 在有限整环 D 中，非零元素 a 的乘法映射 x↦ax 是单射，有限性使它成为满射，从而方程 ax=1 有解。
In a finite domain D, multiplication by a nonzero a is injective. Finiteness makes it surjective, so ax=1 has a solution.
proof: 若 ax=ay，由消去律得 x=y，所以映射 D→D 为单射。
Cancellation makes x↦ax an injection D→D.
有限集合到自身的单射必满射，故存在 b∈D 使 ab=1；交换性又给出 ba=1。
An injection of a finite set into itself is surjective. Thus ab=1 for some b, and commutativity gives ba=1.
a 是任意非零元素，因此 D 的所有非零元素都可逆。
Every nonzero element is therefore a unit.
warning: 有限性不能省略：ℤ 是无限整环，而 x↦2x 不满射。
Finiteness is essential: x↦2x on the infinite domain ℤ is not surjective.

title: 除环与四元数
Division rings and quaternions
text: 除环要求每个非零元素可逆，但不要求乘法交换。四元数 ℍ 的元素为 a+bi+cj+dk（实系数），是非交换除环；教材将非交换除环称为“体”。
A division ring has an inverse for every nonzero element, without requiring commutativity. The real quaternions a+bi+cj+dk form a noncommutative division ring, called a skew field in the textbook.
proof: 用复矩阵模型 [[α,β],[−β̄,ᾱ]]（α=a+bi，β=c+di）定义乘法。模型对加法与乘法封闭，结合律与分配律从矩阵继承。
Use complex matrices [[α,β],[−β̄,ᾱ]], with α=a+bi and β=c+di. Closure, associativity and distributivity follow from matrix operations.
共轭 q̄=a−bi−cj−dk 满足 qq̄=q̄q=a²+b²+c²+d²。
Quaternion conjugation gives qq̄=q̄q=a²+b²+c²+d².
q≠0 时该实数为正，故 q⁻¹=q̄/(a²+b²+c²+d²)。而 ij=−ji，说明不是域。
For q≠0 the norm is positive, so q⁻¹=q̄/(a²+b²+c²+d²). Since ij=−ji, this is not a field.

title: 域的基本性质与分式运算
Basic field properties and fractions
text: 在任意域中，b,d≠0 时通常的分式运算成立。非零系数的一次方程 ax=b 有唯一解 a⁻¹b。域的加法特征可能是正数，所以不能假定 1+1≠0。
For b,d nonzero, ordinary fraction rules hold in every field. The equation ax=b has the unique solution a⁻¹b when a≠0. A field may have positive characteristic, so 1+1 need not be nonzero.
proof: 分式表示 ab⁻¹；两边乘可逆元 bd，得到 a/b=c/d 当且仅当 ad=bc。
A fraction means ab⁻¹. Multiply by the unit bd to obtain the equality criterion.
用分配律与交换律把 ab⁻¹+cd⁻¹ 写成 (ad+bc)(bd)⁻¹，即得到通分规则。
Distributivity and commutativity rewrite ab⁻¹+cd⁻¹ as (ad+bc)(bd)⁻¹.
若 ax=b 且 a≠0，两边乘 a⁻¹ 得 x=a⁻¹b；这个值代回也满足方程，因此存在且唯一。
Multiplying ax=b by a⁻¹ gives x=a⁻¹b; substitution verifies existence and uniqueness.
example: ℚ[√2] 中 (a+b√2)⁻¹=(a−b√2)/(a²−2b²)。对非零元素，分母不能为 0，否则 √2 为有理数（或 a=b=0）。
In ℚ[√2], the inverse is (a−b√2)/(a²−2b²). For a nonzero element the denominator cannot vanish, by the irrationality of √2.

question: ℤ₈ 的非零零因子是哪些？
Which are the nonzero zero-divisors of ℤ₈?
reason: 非零且不与 8 互素的类为 2、4、6；0 不算零因子。
The nonzero classes not coprime to 8 are 2,4,6; zero is excluded.

question: 哪一个是整环但不是域？
Which is a domain but not a field?
reason: ℤ 有单位元、交换且无零因子，但 2 无乘法逆元；2ℤ 没有单位元，ℍ 不交换。
ℤ is unital, commutative and has no zero-divisors, but 2 has no inverse. 2ℤ lacks identity and ℍ is noncommutative.

question: 有限整环证明中，哪一步用到有限性？
Where is finiteness used when proving a finite domain is a field?
options: 单射的乘法映射必满射
reason: 非零 a 的乘法映射由消去律为单射，有限性再把单射升级为满射。
Cancellation gives injectivity; finiteness turns it into surjectivity.

question: 四元数中 ji 等于什么？
What is ji in the quaternions?
reason: The relations are ij=k and ji=−k.

question: 证明在有单位元且 1≠0 的环中，可逆元不可能是左或右零因子。
Prove a unit in a ring with 1≠0 is neither a left nor a right zero-divisor.
reason: 若 ub=0，左乘 u⁻¹ 得 b=0；若 au=0，右乘 u⁻¹ 得 a=0。因此可逆元不可能与非零元乘出 0。此证不要求交换性。
If ub=0, multiply on the left by u⁻¹ to get b=0. If au=0, multiply on the right to get a=0. Commutativity is not needed.
